info.title: hiraku-server API
info.summary: Accounts, cards, players' scores, arcades and machines of a HIRAKU e-AMUSEMENT server.
info.description:
The JSON API of hiraku-server, HIRAKU's e-AMUSEMENT server for many cabinets (docs/SERVER.md).
The cabinets themselves don't use it: they speak the games' own protocol on another port. This
API is for people: the server's own web pages, apps and scripts.

**Experimental.** hiraku-server is a first version. `/api/v1` and its answers may change
between HIRAKU versions while it is experimental; nothing promises compatibility yet. The
server's build is in `GET /health` (`version`).

Everything is JSON (`application/json; charset=utf-8`) in and out, under `/api/v1`. An error is
always `{"error": CODE, "message": TEXT}` with its HTTP status (schema `Error`). Times are whole
seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC; `null` where something never happened.

Who calls: a **session** (`POST /login` sets the `hk_session` cookie and answers a CSRF value,
which every change made with the cookie sends back in `X-HK-CSRF`), or a **personal token**
(`POST /me/tokens`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer hkt_...`; a `read` token changes nothing).
Each operation's role is in its description and in `x-hiraku-role`
(`anyone`, `user`, `operator`, `admin`; roles stack: an admin is an operator, an operator a user).
`x-hiraku-session-only: true`: not with a personal token. `x-hiraku-while-must-change: true`:
allowed to an account that must change its password first (every other operation answers 403
`must_change_password` to it).

The server sends no CORS headers and answers `OPTIONS` with 404: a page on another origin
can't call it from a browser (docs/SERVER-API.md, "Apps on another origin").

servers.description: A server behind its reverse proxy (TLS). Every path below is under /api/v1.
serve's own API port (plain HTTP, this computer only; --api ADDRESS:PORT)

get.summary: Whether the server and its database answer
get.description: Role: anyone. For monitors and containers' health checks.

503.description: The database doesn't answer a query.

get.summary: The server's name, sign-up mode and games
get.description: Role: anyone. What a sign-in page needs before anyone logs in.
Role: anyone. The file docs/openapi.yaml as installed beside the server.
Role: anyone. The file docs/openapi.json (the YAML's twin) as installed beside the server.

post.description:
Role: anyone, as the server's sign-up mode says (`GET /server`'s `signup`): `open`, `invite`
(an invitation's code in `invite`) or `closed`. The new account is a player. It doesn't log
in: call `POST /login` next. At most 5 sign-ups an hour from one address (429).

Role: anyone. Sets the session cookie `hk_session` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/,
Max-Age 30 days, Secure unless serve runs with `--api-insecure-cookies`) and answers the
session's CSRF value: send it as `X-HK-CSRF` with every change made with the cookie. A
session lasts 30 days from its last use. At most 10 tries a minute from one address and 10
for one name (429). A wrong name and a wrong password answer the same.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset code
post.description:
Role: anyone. The code is one an admin made (`POST /users/{name}/reset`), good once, for a
day. `name`, when given, must be the code's user. Counts against log-in's 10 tries a minute
from one address.

Role: user. Ends the session and clears the cookie. With a personal token it answers
`{"ok": true}` and changes nothing (the token stays: revoke it with
`DELETE /me/tokens/{id}`); a `read` token is refused (403).

get.description:
Role: user (also while the password must be changed). With a session it gives the session's
CSRF value again (`csrf`: a page loaded again finds it here); with a token, the token's
`scope`.

post.description:
Role: user, with a session only (not a token), also while the password must be changed. A
wrong `old_password` answers 403 `wrong_password`. Other sessions and tokens of the account
go on.

put.summary: Hide or show one's stats to other players
put.description: Role: user. Hidden stats are left out of `GET /players`, `GET /players/{name}/stats` (403 `stats_hidden`) and the best scores; admins still see them.

get.description: Role: user, with a session only.

post.summary: Make a personal token (its text shown once)
post.description:
Role: user, with a session only. The answer is the only time the token's text is given:
keep it. 50 tokens an account at most (409). A token lasts until it is revoked, its account
disabled or removed.

delete.description: Role: user, with a session only. The token stops at once. Another account's token, or an id that isn't a number: 404.

get.summary: The cards linked to one's account
get.description: Role: user. Card numbers as the server keeps them (upper case), first linked first.

post.summary: Link a card by its PIN
post.description:
Role: user. The card must have played on this server (404 if not) and be no one's (409).
`pin` is the card's PIN as any of its games keeps it. A wrong PIN answers 403 `wrong_pin`
with `tries_left`; the fifth wrong PIN in a row locks the card for linking (403
`card_locked`, `locked: true`, `tries_left: 0`) until an admin unlocks it. 20 tries an hour
an account, successful ones included (429). The answer's `card` is the number as sent.

403.description:
Refused: `wrong_pin` (with `tries_left`), `card_locked` (with `locked` and `tries_left`
0), or any 403 of `Forbidden` (csrf, read_only_token, must_change_password).

value.message: wrong PIN (or the card has none kept): 3 tries left before the card is locked for linking
wrong PIN: the card is now locked for linking (an admin unlocks it)

delete.description: Role: user. The card's players and scores stay on the server; the card can be linked again. Not one of the account's cards: 404.

get.summary: One's own players and scores, every linked card's games
get.description: Role: user. Each stat carries its `card` (one's own).
Role: user. Accounts with at least one card linked, not disabled, not hiding their stats; by name, any case.

Role: user. Never the card numbers (no `card`), except to the account itself and to admins.
Stats hidden by their owner: 403 `stats_hidden` (admins see them). `name` in the answer is
the name as sent in the path.
Role: user. `scores`: whether the server reads the game's scores (its stats and best scores).

get.summary: The game's song and chart names, from the server's names pack
get.description:
Role: user. Songs by the game's own song number (a score's `song`), charts by number. Empty
objects when the server has no names pack for the game (docs/SERVER.md, "Song names").
Texts are cut at 200 characters.

Role: user. Best first, scores above 0 only, among players whose stats show (a card linked
to no account counts, by the game's player name). No card numbers. A game whose scores the
server doesn't read: 404. No paging: `limit` rows at most.
Role: operator.

post.description:
Role: operator. The arcade is the caller's; `owner` gives it to another operator (an
admin's only; an operator may name itself). The games see the arcade's name and
prefecture.

get.description: Role: operator. Another operator's arcade, or an id that isn't a number: 404.

put.summary: Rename an arcade or change its prefecture
put.description:
Role: operator. Each field given is changed in turn (name, then prefecture); a refusal
stops there, and what was changed before it stays. Answers the arcade as it is now.

delete.summary: Remove an arcade, its machines and settings with it
delete.description: Role: operator. Its machines' keys stop at once.

get.description: Role: operator. By name, then PCBID.

post.summary: Add a machine (its key shown once)
post.description:
Role: operator. The server picks the PCBID (20 hex digits) and makes the machine's key,
`hk2.PCBID.SECRET`: the answer is the only time it is given. The cabinet is started with it
(`-eakey`, or the launcher's Server key).

get.description: Role: operator (an admin's: all). By arcade, name, PCBID.
Role: operator. Another operator's machine: 404.

put.summary: Rename, enable or disable a machine
put.description:
Role: operator. A disabled machine's calls are refused at once. Each field given is changed
in turn (name, then enabled); a refusal stops there, what was changed before it stays.

delete.summary: Remove a machine and its key

post.summary: A new key for a machine (shown once); the old one stops

get.summary: Each game's settings for the arcade's machines
get.description:
Role: operator. For each setting: the arcade's own `value` (null: none, the server's
applies), the server's `server_value` (null: none, the default applies), the `default`, and
for a form its `label`, `help`, `kind` and, for a number, `min` and `max`. Values are text.

put.summary: Set some of the arcade's settings
put.description:
Role: operator. Each item is set in turn; the first refused stops there (what was set before
it stays) and is the answer. `value` null or missing clears the arcade's own value.
Answers every setting as `GET` does.

get.description: Role: admin. In the order they were made. No paging.
Role: admin.

put.summary: Change an account's role, whether it is disabled, whether its stats hide
put.description:
Role: admin. Each field given is changed in turn (role, disabled, hide_stats); a refusal
stops there, what was changed before it stays. The last admin stays an enabled admin (409).
A disabled account's sessions and tokens stop at once.

delete.description: Role: admin. Its cards are unlinked (their players and scores stay), its arcades become no one's; the last admin stays (409).

get.summary: The cards linked to an account
get.description: Role: admin.

post.summary: A password reset code for an account (shown once, good for a day)
post.description: Role: admin. A new code replaces the account's older one. The account's user sets a new password with it: `POST /reset`. No body.

get.summary: The server's name, sign-up mode, and whether every game is listed
get.description: Role: admin.

put.summary: Change the server's name, sign-up mode or game listing
put.description: Role: admin. Each field given is changed in turn (name, signup, list_all_games); a refusal stops there.

post.description: Role: admin. For `uses` sign-ups (1 by default) within `days` days (7 by default). The body may be empty.

get.summary: A card as an admin sees it (never its PIN)
get.description: Role: admin. A card the server doesn't know answers 200 with `known: false` (not 404).

delete.summary: Unlink a card from its account
delete.description: Role: admin. A card linked to no account: 404.

post.summary: Unlock a card locked by wrong PINs
post.description: Role: admin. No body. A card that isn't locked answers 403 `card_locked` ("the card ... isn't locked").

put.summary: Set a card's PIN in every place the games keep it
put.description:
Role: admin. `changed` and `not_changed` name the games (plain words, for a person).
Done in some places only: still 200, with `complete: false`. Done nowhere: the refusal
(400 `bad_request` when nothing could be written).

not_changed: pop'n music 10 (the PIN's place in its record isn't known)

get.summary: The server's own settings and every game's server-wide values
get.description: Role: admin. `server`: the server's own settings; `games`: each game's, as for an arcade but without `server_value` (`value` is the server's).

put.description:
Role: admin. As `PUT /arcades/{id}/settings`; `game: "server"` names the server's own
settings. Answers every setting as `GET` does.

get.summary: The song names' packs loaded and refused
get.description: Role: admin. `set`: a names folder is configured. Files by name only, never a path.
Role: admin. The newest `limit` lines, oldest of them first. Never a password, PIN or code in them.

sessionCookie.name: hk_session
sessionCookie.description:
A log-in's session, set by `POST /login` (`hks_` and 64 hex digits; HttpOnly,
SameSite=Strict, Secure). Lasts 30 days from its last use; ends at `POST /logout`, or at
once when the account is disabled or removed.

csrfHeader.name: X-HK-CSRF
csrfHeader.description:
The session's CSRF value (`csrf` of `POST /login` and of `GET /me`): needed with the cookie
on every request that isn't a GET to an operation that needs a log-in, else 403 `csrf`.

bearerToken.description:
A personal token (`POST /me/tokens`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer hkt_...`. Scope `read`:
GET only (anything else 403 `read_only_token`); `write`: everything a session may, except the
session-only operations. No CSRF value. A wrong or revoked token is 401 on every operation
that needs a log-in (a public one goes on as if no one were logged in).

Card.name: card
Card.description: A card number as the games send it (16 characters, any case; URL-encode it).

ArcadeId.name: id
ArcadeId.description: An arcade's id. Anything but a whole number from 1 answers 404.

TokenId.name: id
TokenId.description: A token's id. Anything but a whole number from 1 answers 404.

GameId.name: id
GameId.description: A game's id, as `GET /games` lists it (exact case).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit lets the caller in again.

BadRequest.description:
`bad_json`: the body isn't a JSON object (checked before anything else, on every request
but a GET); `bad_request`: a field missing, of the wrong type, out of range, or a value that
isn't one (a name's or password's shape, a setting's value...); the message says which.

Unauthorized.description:
`not_signed_in`: no session or token where one is needed, or one that isn't (ended, revoked,
its account disabled); `wrong_password` (`POST /login` only).

Forbidden.description:
In the order the server checks them: `session_only` (a token where a log-in is needed),
`must_change_password`, `read_only_token`, `csrf`, `not_allowed` (the role isn't enough, or
not this account's); then the operation's own: `wrong_password` (an old password),
`disabled`, `stats_hidden`, `signup_refused`, `bad_code`, `card_locked`, `wrong_pin`.

example.message: a change needs the log-in's CSRF value in X-HK-CSRF

NotFound.description: `not_found`: no such thing (or one the caller may not see: another operator's arcade or machine), or no such path in the API.

Conflict.description: `conflict`: taken already, another's, the last admin, or a limit on how many reached (50 tokens).

example.message: the body is 64 KiB at most

TooManyRequests.description:
`slow_down`: too many calls. 600 a minute a session or token (or an address, when no one is
logged in); log-in and reset 10 a minute an address, log-in 10 a minute a name; sign-up 5
an hour an address; card links 20 an hour an account.

example.message: too many tries: again in 42 s

ServerError.description: `server_error`: the database or the system failed.

example.message: the server could not answer that

ReadOnly.description: `read_only`: the database was written by a newer hiraku-server; this one changes nothing in it.

example.message: the database is a newer HIRAKU's: nothing is changed

TimeOrNull.description: Seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC; null when it never happened.

UserName.description: 1 to 32 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', not beginning with '-' or '.'; unique in any case.

Label.description: 1 to 64 bytes of one line, no control characters (an arcade's, a machine's, a token's, the server's name).

Error.description: Every error's answer. `message` is for a person; act on `error`.

tries_left.description: A refused card link (`wrong_pin`, `card_locked`) only. Wrong PINs left before the card is locked for linking.

locked.description: `card_locked` of a card link only: always true.

Shows.description:
What a game's rows can ever hold (the game's, not one player's): `plays` a player's count
of plays, `song_plays` a chart's own count, `clear` a clear mark with a word for it. A page
leaves out a column that can only be empty.

name.description: The server's name for people ("HIRAKU" until an admin names it).

has_names.description: The server has a names pack for it (`GET /games/{id}/songs`).

invite.description: An invitation's code, when sign-up is by invitation.

must_change_password.description: Every operation but a few answers 403 `must_change_password` until it is changed.

csrf.description: The session's CSRF value (64 hex digits): send it as X-HK-CSRF with every change.
With a session only: its CSRF value.

last_used.description: Noted once an hour at most.

token.description: The token's text, given this once only: `hkt_` and 64 hex digits.

pin.description: As any of the card's games keeps it (usually four digits).

ScoreRow.description: One chart's record in a player's stats, in the game's own numbers.

score.description: null: none kept (a failed stage of a System 573 game). A score of 0 is kept here, never among the best scores.

plays.description: The chart's count of plays; null: the game keeps none.

clear.description: The game's own clear mark; null: none.

clear_name.description: The mark as a short word ("Cleared", "Failed", "Full combo"...); null: none, or its meaning isn't known.

GameStat.description: One card's player in one game.

plays.description: The player's count of plays; null: not kept.

card.description: The card's number: to its own account and to admins only.

player.description: The game's player name, as UTF-8; "" when it can't be made text (then `player_hex`).

player_hex.description: The name's bytes as the game keeps them, in hex, when `player` is "" for that reason.

scores.description: The server reads its scores (stats, best scores).

songs.description: By the game's song number, as text.

charts.description: Chart names by chart number, as text.

rank.description: 1 for the best; equal scores get the next rank each.

user.description: The account the card is linked to; null: none.

Prefecture.description: Japan's prefecture number (JIS X 0401), 1 to 47; 13 is Tokyo. The games show it.

owner.description: The operator's name; null: no one's (its owner's account was removed: the admins').

last_seen.description: Its last call (noted once a minute at most); null: never.

Setting.description: One setting, with what a form needs.

value.description: The arcade's own value (or the server's, where there is no arcade); null: none.

server_value.description: An arcade's answer only: the server's value; null: none.

code.description: 32 hex digits, given this once only.

list_all_games.description: The games' rows the server marks unlisted are listed too.

code.description: 32 hex digits, given this once only.

card.description: As the server keeps it when known, else as asked.

known.description: A game has a player on it.

wrong_pins.description: Wrong PINs since the last link or unlock.
